text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hm? Did someone call for me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hmm~, nobody's here? That's so weird~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So you're the one who called me here, 
Three Goddesses Statue!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, as if that'd ever happen! Even the 
Goddesses have frozen in shock! Wahahaha~!
